overview.title: Agent-usable EffectCraft (ArtCraft/storytold, an After Effects-style compositor in Rust) through its headless CLI: commands, comps and layers as a CL Scene, scripted edits, frames and renders.

mod.effectcraft.verify.effect: Real round trip on a real Neyvia capture: new comp, import, keyframed push-in, a title with Drop Shadow and a fade, observe as a Scene, one frame, a 3 s H.264 render, then the outcome contracts on the decoded file.
mod.effectcraft.verify.pre: Selected workspace; the mod is installed, enabled and its local tool is present

verify-effectcraft.goal: Run the real round trip and check its outcome contracts

pitfalls.recovery: Build or point the NEYVIA_* path at it; the action refuses rather than downloading anything.

pitfalls.failure: A render exists but is wrong
pitfalls.recovery: Read the outcome block (duration, frames, black/frozen runs, clipping); never call a render good from its exit code.

frontier: Built from source (effectcraft 0.3.1, needs Rust 1.95 or newer) with a Rust 1.99 toolchain kept on D:/NeyviaRuns/toolchains into D:/NeyviaRuns/video/track-video/target/effectcraft; set NEYVIA_EFFECTCRAFT_CLI to use another build.
Adapted, not forked: every action runs the unmodified upstream program. EffectCraft by the ArtCraft team, MIT OR Apache-2.0, https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft.
guidance: Comps and layers are addressed by id or name; properties by path (mod.effectcraft.info lists them).

A run step is an engine command id with JSON params, e.g. comp.new {name,width,height,frameRate,duration}, file.import {paths}, layer.addItem {item,time,duration}, layer.newText {text,name,size,fill,position}, effect.apply {effect,layers}, prop.addKey {layer,path,time,value}; find others with mod.effectcraft.commands.
Use frames for quick looks and render for the outcome contracts.
Installs switched off from Marketplace > Apps & mods; read this manual and the declared permissions, then enable it.
